*trick /trɪk/n. 诡计 fight /faɪt/v. 打仗；战斗

blocks.title: 三、重点句型
blocks.text:
1.Outsidethemain gate ofthecity stood ahuge wooden horse.一匹巨大的木马矗立在城外。
2.It's so big that they couldn't takeit with them.它太大了，以至于他们无法带走。
3.Then they madesure all thegates of thecity were locked,andwent to bed.
随后他们确认城门已全部锁好，便去睡了。
4.By midnight,themain square was empty,except for thehuge horse.
到了午夜，主广场空荡荡的，除了那匹巨大的木马。
5.These soldiers secretly came back whiletheTrojans were celebrating.
这些士兵在特洛伊人庆祝的时候偷偷地回来了。
6.The Greeks spent ten years trying totake over thecity ofTroy.
希腊人花了十年时间试图占领特洛伊城。
7.In the end, they succeeded in capturing it injust one night with aclever trick—and without any fighting.
最终，他们巧施妙计，在短短一个晚上便成功将其攻取 —— 而且没有发生任何战斗。
Unit6Wisdomcounts 单元核心知识
8.In the early morning ofthe thirdday, heasked his soldiers to fill20large boats with straw men.
第三天清晨，他让士兵们用稻草人把 20 艘大船装满。
9.There were more than 100,000ofthem.有超过十万支箭。
10.Ihave never been to Greece, butmycousin visited thecountry lastyear.
我从未去过希腊，但我表姐去年去了那个国家。
